name: COVID-19 Wage Subsidy Scheme (March 2021)
description: The COVID-19 Wage Subsidy Scheme (March 2021) provides financial assistance to eligible businesses experiencing a decline in revenue due to a current escalation in COVID-19 Alert Levels.

attributes.summary: A wage subsidy scheme providing support to New Zealand businesses affected by COVID-19 Alert Level escalations in March 2021, requiring businesses to retain named workers and meet revenue decline thresholds.
attributes.eligibility: Business is registered and operating in New Zealand; Worker is legally working in New Zealand; 40% decline in revenue due to current escalation in Alert Levels; Business must retain workers named in their application; State Sector employers generally not eligible; Health and disability funded workforce specific rules apply.
attributes.payment_details: Subsidy paid to businesses based on number of named workers; businesses must pay workers at least ordinary wages or salary.
attributes.obligations: Business must retain workers named in their application; unused funds must be repaid after the subsidy period; treatment of the subsidy considered when granting benefits.
